core_obligations: Affine base reduction: properness is local on the base; the (3)-condition restricts to opens because A^n x X_alpha is the preimage of A^n x S_alpha and the closure argument 1xf(Zbar) cap A^n x S_alpha = 1xf(Z) keeps images closed.
Chow reduction: Chow's lemma gives X' -> X proper surjective with X' -> P^n_S an immersion; X proper iff X' -> P^n_S is a closed immersion (image-proper and composition arguments).

(3)=>(1) close: (3) plus the standard covering of projective space makes X x P^n -> S x P^n closed; base change and the section-to-separated-map argument make X' -> P^n_S proper, hence a closed immersion; conclude f proper.
proof_roadmap: Affine base reduction via the closure computation.
Chow reduction and the closed immersion equivalence.
difficulty_reason: Two proofs in the source env: a pointer first proof and a substantial second proof - affine base reduction with a topological closure argument, Chow's lemma reduction, the properness equivalence of X' -> P^n_S being a closed immersion, and the section/projection argument closing the (3)=>(1) direction.

compared.difference: The sibling tests universal closedness at a finite level of a limit system (delivered as L30207); this lemma is the A^n base change criterion with its own second proof. Different statements.

dedup.scope: Targeted comparison within limits.tex; no same-claim card exists.
